investigations.name: dnaa-00-stage1-baseline
investigations.description:
Foundational prerequisite study. The DnaA / replication-initiation arc is calibrated against
the Stage 1 parameter spec in *Parameters for WCM (Stage 1 heuristic values).pdf*, which
prescribes ABT minimal glycerol as the canonical condition — its τ=150 min puts replication
on non-overlapping cycles and avoids the synchronisation artefacts of faster conditions.

Two distinct experimental tracks happen here:

- **Glycerol Stage 1 track (the deliverable).** New MIX0-845 media row + glycerol condition_defs
  entry + the full Stage 1 parameter overrides (C=70 via replisome_rate, D=30 via build_cache.py,
  DnaA TE=1, DnaA stable, DARS / datA window edits). Output cache at
  `out/cache_glycerol_stage1`. Single-gen smoke-test confirmed at 121 min cycle.

- **Acetate diagnostic track (reference for vEcoli equivalence + the multi-gen hypothesis test).**
  Canonical cache, no Stage 1 overrides. Used to (a) verify v2ecoli single-gen acetate matches
  vEcoli within 15% on ppGpp / charged-fraction / elongation / cell mass — confirms the v2ecoli
  refactor is faithful, (b) test whether the wcEcoli-inherited observed-vs-declared cycle-time
  gap (~80 min vs τ=136) is a transient that 5+ generations would wash out — it is not.

This study is NOT new mechanism (Studies 2-6 do that). It is *getting the dials right* before
any new process is wired.

investigations.name: dnaa-01-expression-dynamics
investigations.description: Foundational study for the DnaA / replication-initiation arc. Wires the dnaA promoter + mRNA + protein layer so that DnaA copy number tracks the mass-spec / EcoCyc range (~300-800 per cell, or ~200 per oriC by western blots) during steady-state slow growth. Includes promoter occupancy state for dnaAp DnaA boxes and a placeholder autorepression rule (DnaA-bound dnaAp → lower transcription rate, exposed as a tunable parameter). The full structural model of dnaAp (two consensus DnaA boxes + two DnaA-ATP-specific boxes) is deferred to Study 2 / 3.

investigations.name: dnaa-02-atp-hydrolysis
investigations.description: Second study in the DnaA arc. Splits the DnaA pool from Study 1 into three nucleotide-bound forms (DnaA-ATP, DnaA-ADP, apo-DnaA) and adds intrinsic ATP hydrolysis. Sets up the substrate for Studies 3 (box binding) and 5 (extrinsic ATP/ADP conversion via RIDA/DDAH/DARS).

investigations.name: dnaa-03-box-binding
investigations.description: Third study in the DnaA arc. Builds the chromosome-scale DnaA-box occupancy state. Visualizes occupancy at oriC, high-affinity sites, low-affinity sites, and total chromosome. Sets up the substrate for Study 4 (mechanistic initiation gate based on oriC occupancy).

investigations.name: dnaa-04-mechanistic-initiation
investigations.description: The keystone study of the arc. Wires the mechanism — instead of "initiate at mass threshold", initiation fires when oriC has the right DnaA-ATP occupancy pattern. Slow growth + constant C / D period (40 min C, 30 min D per the plan) keeps the scope tractable. Generates the result that ultimately closes the gap flagged by the investigation's acceptance criterion multi_gen_equilibrates_toward_declared_tau (FAILED). If mechanistic initiation produces emergent cycle times closer to declared τ, this study supersedes the FBA-over-supply workaround.

investigations.name: dnaa-05-rida-ddah-dars
investigations.description: Adds the full DnaA-ATP/ADP conversion cycle that controls initiation synchrony. RIDA activity scales with replication-fork count (more forks → more inactivation). DDAH activity scales with datA copy number. DARS1 + DARS2 activities each scale with their respective loci copy numbers. Replaces any Study-2 heuristic ratio clamp with a mechanism.

investigations.name: dnaa-06-seqa-sequestration
investigations.description: Adds the eclipse-period regulator that prevents back-to-back initiations on the newly-replicated oriC. SeqA tetramers bind hemimethylated GATC sites cooperatively. Stub-level per the plan PDF (only "Cooperativity" listed under Required knowledge) — full design happens when this study activates.

investigations.name: dnaa-07-cooperativity
investigations.description: Stub-level per the plan PDF (all sections empty in the source PDF). Full design happens when this study activates.

investigations.name: dnaa-08-validation
investigations.description: Final study in the DnaA arc. Stub-level per the plan PDF. Full design happens when Studies 1-7 have closed.

investigations.name: dnaa-context-condition-landscape
investigations.description:
Sits ahead of Study 0 in the investigation. A reader landing on the chromosome-cycle-calibration
investigation should read THIS first — five minutes here will save twenty minutes of "wait,
why are they running two different conditions?" later.

Three things to take away:

1. **v2ecoli ships with 5 canonical conditions, none of which are ABT glycerol.** The set —
   `with_aa` (τ=25 min), `basal` (τ=44 min), `succinate` (τ=82 min), `no_oxygen` (τ=100 min),
   `acetate` (τ=136 min). All share C=40 min (replication time) + D=20 min (eclipse), giving
   C+D=60 min globally. Any condition with τ < C+D = 60 min has overlapping replication cycles
   (multi-fork) — that's `with_aa` (and arguably `basal` near the boundary).

2. **The Stage 1 PDF chose ABT minimal glycerol (MIX0-845, τ=150 min) deliberately.** From the
   PDF: "Growth condition is ABT minimal glycerol for wildtype MG1655. This is to guarantee
   non-overlapping cell cycle, which avoids synchronization issue." Multi-fork replication
   creates initiation events that overlap in time and chromosome dosage that's a function of
   where in the cycle each fork sits — both bury the signal the DnaA / replication-initiation
   arc is trying to study. Stage 1 also prescribes C=70 + D=30 (C+D=100 min), pushing the
   multi-fork threshold up too.

3. **Acetate (τ=136) is the closest analog to glycerol in v2ecoli's existing set.** Both have
   1 oriC + 0 active forks at t=0 (non-multi-fork). Both are slow enough that C+D fits within
   τ. Critically — acetate has an established vEcoli implementation on the same kb_default
   simData, so we can run a side-by-side v2ecoli ↔ vEcoli match to verify the v2ecoli refactor
   is faithful. Glycerol doesn't have that reference (it's a NEW condition we added). Acetate
   is therefore the v2ecoli refactor's validation point; glycerol is the Stage 1 deliverable.

The embedded HTML below carries the full per-condition observable table (τ observed,
initial dry mass, mass-fold-change, oriC counts, fork counts, multi-fork yes/no) plus an
animation of the 5 baseline simulations side-by-side. Use it to compare the conditions visually.
